issue.title: [Bug]: Simple Tab Groups does not fully hide tabs from inactive groups when switching groups
issue.body: ## Pre-Submission Checklist - [x] I have checked the existing/closed issues to ensure this issue has not already been reported. - [x] I am using the latest supported version of the browser. - [x] I have tried disabling all browser extensions/add-ons to rule out interference from these. - [x] I have tried clearing the browser cache and cookies. - [x] I have checked with a new profile and the issue still occurs. - [x] I have provided detailed step-by-step instructions on how to reproduce the issue. - [x] I have included relevant screenshots or console outputs. - [x] I have checked that this problem is not occurring in the latest version of Firefox. - [x] This issue is specific to this browser and does not occur in other browsers. ## Bug Summary When switching tab groups with the Simple Tab Groups extension in Floorp, tabs from the previously active group are not always fully hidden. As a result, tabs from another group can remain visible in the tab strip, which breaks group isolation and causes confusion. ## Reproduction Steps 1. Install Floorp (latest stable) on Windows 10. 2. Install the extension **Simple Tab Groups**. 3. Create at least 2 tab groups (for example: Group 1 and Group 2). 4. Open several tabs in Group 1. 5. Switch to Group 2 using the extension UI. 6. Repeat switching between groups a few times. 7. Observe the tab strip after switching. ## Expected Behavior After switching to another group, only tabs belonging to the currently active group should be visible. Tabs from inactive groups should be completely hidden every time. ## Actual Behavior After group switching, some tabs from a previously active group remain visible in the tab strip (partial/incomplete hiding). This appears intermittently but is reproducible with repeated switching. ## Screenshots I prepared two screenshots showing: - Screenshot 1: normal/expected grouped view. - Screenshot 2: after switching groups, tabs from another group are still visible (incomplete hiding). (If needed, I can provide additional screenshots/video and precise extension version in a follow-up comment.) ## Browser Version Floorp 12.12.2 ## Operating System Windows 10 (build 10.0.26200) ## Additional Context The issue seems related to tab visibility/state synchronization when group switching is triggered by Simple Tab Groups. This behavior impacts workflow because group boundaries are no longer visually reliable.
